# Hooks

> Accounts\, paid for through a payment processor that reports payments to RecordPaymentEvent\.

Every page below is Markdown. Requests are JSON over HTTP; each operation's page gives its method and URI, its headers, its request and response with an example, its errors and its pagination. Send `Authorization: Bearer <token>` unless an operation's page says it takes no credential. Send `Crucible-Version: 2026-10-01` on every request you make; an operation a third party calls says what its sender sends instead. `describe.json` holds the whole reference as data (`crucible.describe/1`).

## Overview

- [Service overview](src/index.md): protocol, authentication, service errors, and the operations of each resource

## Operations

- [GetAccount](src/operations/API_GetAccount.md): `GET /accounts/{accountId}`. Read an account\.
- [RecordPaymentEvent](src/operations/API_RecordPaymentEvent.md): `POST /payment-events`. Called by Payments Inc\., which signs it in the `Payment-Signature` header. Receive an event from the payment processor\.
- [ReportLeakedKeys](src/operations/API_ReportLeakedKeys.md): `POST /leaked-keys`. Called by CodeHost, which signs it in the `Scanner-Signature` header. Receive a report of leaked keys from a code host\'s secret scanner\.

## Data types

- [AccessDenied](src/shapes/AccessDenied.md): error, HTTP 403. A request that is not signed\, or not signed by the sender\.
- [AccountId](src/shapes/AccountId.md): string.
- [GetAccountInput](src/shapes/GetAccountInput.md): structure.
- [GetAccountOutput](src/shapes/GetAccountOutput.md): structure.
- [LeakedKey](src/shapes/LeakedKey.md): structure. A key the scanner found in public\.
- [LeakedKeys](src/shapes/LeakedKeys.md): list.
- [PaymentEventBody](src/shapes/PaymentEventBody.md): blob. The event as the processor sent it\, unparsed\, so the signature is checked over exactly those bytes\.
- [PaymentSignature](src/shapes/PaymentSignature.md): string. The processor\'s signature\: a timestamp and an HMAC of the exact body\.
- [RecordPaymentEventInput](src/shapes/RecordPaymentEventInput.md): structure.
- [RecordPaymentEventOutput](src/shapes/RecordPaymentEventOutput.md): structure.
- [ReportLeakedKeysInput](src/shapes/ReportLeakedKeysInput.md): structure.

## Optional

- [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt): every page above in one file
- [describe.json](describe.json): the whole reference as JSON (`crucible.describe/1`)
- [changes.json](changes.json): the release chain alone (`crucible.changes/1`)
